notes: Stable Source Documents release. Verified end-to-end on Windows with a passport and a two-image Global Entry document: Add, destination authorization, ChatGPT extraction, guarded JSON paste/manual paste, field application, Save, side-by-side original verification, Mark Verified & Finish, archive, and retained-source Document Library display. Windows uses Open ChatGPT + Copy Request without the unsupported Share sheet; iPhone/iPad retain the native Share workflow. Multi-image originals are recognized as embedded review sources, and Global Entry completeness uses Name, PASSID, and Expiration date rather than passport-only requirements. ChatGPT handoff guidance and event handling are consolidated into one authoritative runtime path.
name: TEE v3.4.27 — Stable Source Documents Workflow
